name: Hasekura Heath
source:
Full of manly spirit, he has a dependable aura. A half-blood of British mother. Has two sisters, [url=/c43022]one[/url] is apparently president of a company, the [url=/c43024]other[/url] is a model. Heath himself also models sometimes  against his will.

[From [url=http://posweb.jp/pos/character/hounan/05.html]Official website[/url]]
